answer.rationale: The low-cost vendor is the current primary supplier and has quoted a price that meets the mandated 18% component spend cut. Memory c2 confirms that moving to this vendor last year cut unit cost sharply with quick onboarding and accurate invoicing, indicating reliable low-cost supply. Memory c1 shows that renewing with the incumbent preserves integration stability and avoids delivery interruption. With the assembly line at 94% of committed volume and no buffer, any switch or delay would increase delivery risk. Renewing the incumbent at its quoted price directly satisfies the cost mandate while maintaining the existing stable flow, thus minimizing total cost of ownership without increasing delivery risk.
